title: "In-Week Fantasy Outliers: Vegas, Divisional, Pace & Game-Environment Factors"
output: html_document
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6.5, dpi = 200)

library(tidyverse)
library(nflreadr)
library(gt)

# ======================= PARAMETERS =======================
SEASONS  <- 2020:get_current_season()   # last season = out-of-sample test set
THRU_WK  <- 10                          # last week of the current season to include
SCORING  <- "fantasy_points_ppr"        # or "fantasy_points" (standard)
Z_CUT    <- 2                           # outlier = z-score >= this within week & position

PRIOR_N         <- 4                    # rolling window for all "prior" stats (team games)
MIN_PRIOR_GAMES <- 2                    # need at least this many prior games in-season

# Player pool is defined from PRIOR volume only (knowable before kickoff), so the
# outlier flag is not conditioned on what happened in the game itself.
MIN_PRIOR_VOL <- c(QB = 15, RB = 6, WR = 3, TE = 2.5)  # QB att | RB car+tgt | WR/TE tgt, per game

CREDIT <- "@rohinmishra / rohinm.substack.com"
# ==========================================================
```

```{r helpers-data}
# Mean of the previous k values (excludes the current game). NA if < min_n available.
roll_prior <- function(x, k = PRIOR_N, min_n = MIN_PRIOR_GAMES) {
  m <- do.call(cbind, lapply(seq_len(k), function(i) dplyr::lag(x, i)))
  n <- rowSums(!is.na(m))
  out <- rowMeans(m, na.rm = TRUE)
  out[n < min_n] <- NA_real_
  out
}

# Quintile bins with readable labels
qbin <- function(x, k = 5) {
  labs <- c("Q1 (low)", paste0("Q", 2:(k - 1)), paste0("Q", k, " (high)"))
  factor(labs[ntile(x, k)], levels = labs)
}
```

```{r data}
# ---- 1) Schedules -> one row per team-game (home + away built directly so
#         neutral-site spreads keep the right sign) ----
sched <- load_schedules(SEASONS) %>%
  filter(game_type == "REG", !is.na(result),
         season < max(SEASONS) | week <= THRU_WK)

lines <- bind_rows(
  sched %>% transmute(game_id, season, week, team = home_team, opponent = away_team,
                      venue = if_else(location == "Neutral", "Neutral", "Home"),
                      team_spread = spread_line, rest = home_rest,
                      team_score = home_score, opp_score = away_score),
  sched %>% transmute(game_id, season, week, team = away_team, opponent = home_team,
                      venue = if_else(location == "Neutral", "Neutral", "Away"),
                      team_spread = -spread_line, rest = away_rest,
                      team_score = away_score, opp_score = home_score)
) %>%
  left_join(sched %>% select(game_id, total_line, div_game, roof, temp, wind, weekday, gametime),
            by = "game_id") %>%
  mutate(
    implied_tt = total_line / 2 + team_spread / 2,          # spread + = favored
    game_total = team_score + opp_score,
    divisional = if_else(div_game == 1, "Divisional", "Non-divisional"),
    indoor     = roof %in% c("dome", "closed"),
    wind_f     = if_else(indoor, 0, as.numeric(wind)),
    temp_f     = if_else(indoor, 70, as.numeric(temp)),
    primetime  = coalesce(weekday != "Sunday" | gametime >= "19:00", FALSE),
    rest_bin   = factor(case_when(rest <= 5  ~ "Short (<=5 days)",
                                  rest >= 10 ~ "Long / off bye (10+)",
                                  TRUE       ~ "Normal (6-9)"),
                        levels = c("Short (<=5 days)", "Normal (6-9)", "Long / off bye (10+)"))
  )

# ---- 2) Team pace & PROE per game from play-by-play ----
pbp_cols <- c("game_id", "season", "week", "season_type", "posteam", "defteam", "pass", "rush",
              "qb_kneel", "qb_spike", "xpass", "wp", "down", "half_seconds_remaining")

pbp <- map_dfr(SEASONS, ~ load_pbp(.x) %>% select(any_of(pbp_cols))) %>%
  filter(season_type == "REG", !is.na(posteam), pass == 1 | rush == 1,
         coalesce(qb_kneel, 0) == 0, coalesce(qb_spike, 0) == 0)

team_game <- pbp %>%
  mutate(neutral = down %in% 1:3 & between(wp, 0.2, 0.8) &
                   half_seconds_remaining > 120 & !is.na(xpass)) %>%
  group_by(game_id, season, week, team = posteam) %>%
  summarise(off_plays = n(),
            proe      = 100 * mean((pass - xpass)[neutral]),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(pbp %>% count(game_id, team = defteam, name = "def_plays"),
            by = c("game_id", "team"))

team_prior <- team_game %>%
  arrange(team, season, week) %>%
  group_by(team, season) %>%
  mutate(team_plays_p4     = roll_prior(off_plays),
         team_def_plays_p4 = roll_prior(def_plays),
         team_proe_p4      = roll_prior(proe)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(season, week, team, team_plays_p4, team_def_plays_p4, team_proe_p4)

# ---- 3) Weekly player stats ----
ps_raw <- tryCatch(load_player_stats(SEASONS, summary_level = "week"),
                   error = function(e) load_player_stats(SEASONS))       # older nflreadr
if (!"team" %in% names(ps_raw) && "recent_team" %in% names(ps_raw))
  ps_raw <- rename(ps_raw, team = recent_team)

ps_all <- ps_raw %>%
  filter(season_type == "REG", position %in% c("QB", "RB", "WR", "TE")) %>%
  transmute(player_id, player = player_display_name, position, season, week, team,
            attempts = coalesce(attempts, 0), carries = coalesce(carries, 0),
            targets  = coalesce(targets, 0),
            fp       = coalesce(.data[[SCORING]], 0)) %>%
  mutate(vol = case_when(position == "QB" ~ attempts,
                         position == "RB" ~ carries + targets,
                         TRUE             ~ targets)) %>%
  semi_join(lines, by = c("season", "week", "team"))

team_vol <- ps_all %>%
  group_by(season, week, team) %>%
  summarise(team_carries = sum(carries), team_targets = sum(targets), .groups = "drop")

ps_all <- ps_all %>%
  left_join(team_vol, by = c("season", "week", "team")) %>%
  mutate(opp_share = (carries + targets) / pmax(team_carries + team_targets, 1)) %>%
  arrange(player_id, season, week) %>%
  group_by(player_id, season) %>%
  mutate(fp_p4    = roll_prior(fp),
         vol_p4   = roll_prior(vol),
         share_p4 = roll_prior(opp_share)) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---- 4) Defense: fantasy points allowed to each position, prior 4 ----
def_allowed <- ps_all %>%
  left_join(lines %>% select(season, week, team, opponent), by = c("season", "week", "team")) %>%
  group_by(season, week, defteam = opponent, position) %>%
  summarise(fp_allowed = sum(fp), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(defteam, position, season, week) %>%
  group_by(defteam, position, season) %>%
  mutate(opp_fp_allowed_p4 = roll_prior(fp_allowed)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(season, week, defteam, position, opp_fp_allowed_p4)

# ---- 5) Assemble + outlier flag ----
df <- ps_all %>%
  inner_join(lines, by = c("season", "week", "team")) %>%
  left_join(team_prior, by = c("season", "week", "team")) %>%
  left_join(team_prior %>% select(season, week, opponent = team,
                                  opp_plays_allowed_p4 = team_def_plays_p4,
                                  opp_plays_p4 = team_plays_p4),
            by = c("season", "week", "opponent")) %>%
  left_join(def_allowed, by = c("season", "week", "opponent" = "defteam", "position")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vol_p4), vol_p4 >= MIN_PRIOR_VOL[position]) %>%
  group_by(season, week, position) %>%
  mutate(z        = (fp - mean(fp)) / sd(fp),
         pos_rank = min_rank(desc(fp)),
         outlier  = z >= Z_CUT) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    position      = factor(position, levels = c("QB", "RB", "WR", "TE")),
    total_bin     = cut(total_line, c(-Inf, 40.5, 43.5, 46.5, 49.5, Inf),
                        labels = c("<=40.5", "41-43.5", "44-46.5", "47-49.5", "50+")),
    spread_bin    = cut(team_spread, c(-Inf, -7.5, -3.5, -0.5, 0.5, 3.5, 7.5, Inf),
                        labels = c("Dog 8+", "Dog 4-7.5", "Dog 1-3.5", "PK",
                                   "Fav 1-3.5", "Fav 4-7.5", "Fav 8+")),
    itt_bin       = cut(implied_tt, c(-Inf, 19, 21.5, 24, 26.5, Inf),
                        labels = c("<19", "19-21.5", "21.5-24", "24-26.5", "26.5+")),
    plays_bin     = qbin(team_plays_p4),
    opp_allow_bin = qbin(opp_plays_allowed_p4),
    proe_bin      = qbin(team_proe_p4),
    wind_bin      = cut(wind_f, c(-Inf, 9.99, 14.99, Inf), labels = c("<10 mph", "10-15 mph", "15+ mph")),
    roof_bin      = if_else(indoor, "Indoor", "Outdoor"),
    prime_bin     = if_else(primetime, "Primetime / non-Sunday", "Sunday day")
  ) %>%
  group_by(position) %>%
  mutate(oppfp_bin = qbin(opp_fp_allowed_p4)) %>%      # position-specific defense quality
  ungroup()

Data_Label <- sprintf("%d-%d REG (thru %d Wk %d) | outlier = z >= %.1f vs. week/position field | priors = last %d games",
                      min(SEASONS), max(SEASONS), max(SEASONS), THRU_WK, Z_CUT, PRIOR_N)
```

list(
  player_games    = nrow(df),
  outliers        = sum(df$outlier),
  by_position     = df %>% count(position, outlier) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = outlier, values_from = n),
  missing_priors  = df %>% summarise(across(c(team_plays_p4, opp_plays_allowed_p4, team_proe_p4,
                                              opp_fp_allowed_p4, fp_p4, share_p4, wind_f, temp_f),
                                            ~ mean(is.na(.x)))),
  divisional_rows = df %>% count(divisional)
)

```{r helpers-plot}
rate_by <- function(data, var, flag = "outlier") {
  base <- data %>% group_by(position) %>% summarise(base = mean(.data[[flag]]), .groups = "drop")
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var]])) %>%
    group_by(position, level = .data[[var]]) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), hits = sum(.data[[flag]]), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(rate = hits / n, z95 = 1.96,
           lo = (rate + z95^2/(2*n) - z95*sqrt(rate*(1-rate)/n + z95^2/(4*n^2))) / (1 + z95^2/n),
           hi = (rate + z95^2/(2*n) + z95*sqrt(rate*(1-rate)/n + z95^2/(4*n^2))) / (1 + z95^2/n)) %>%
    left_join(base, by = "position") %>%
    mutate(lift = rate / base)
}

pos_cols <- c(QB = "#d7301f", RB = "#2171b5", WR = "#238b45", TE = "#6a51a3")

plot_rate <- function(r, xlab, title) {
  ggplot(r, aes(level, rate, fill = position)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0.2, colour = "grey30") +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = base), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n)), y = 0, vjust = -0.4, size = 2.3, colour = "white") +
    facet_wrap(~ position, nrow = 1) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pos_cols, guide = "none") +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Outlier rate", title = title,
         subtitle = paste0(Data_Label, "\ndashed = position baseline | 95% CI"),
         caption = paste("Data: nflreadr / nflfastR |", CREDIT)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8))
}

chi_p <- function(data, var) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var]])) %>%
    group_by(position) %>%
    summarise(p = tryCatch(suppressWarnings(chisq.test(table(.data[[var]], outlier))$p.value),
                           error = function(e) NA_real_),
              .groups = "drop")
}
```

# Divisional games

## Outlier rate: divisional vs. non-divisional

```{r div-rate}
plot_rate(rate_by(df, "divisional"), NULL, "Outlier Rate: Divisional vs. Non-Divisional")

df %>%
  group_by(position) %>%
  summarise(
    div_rate    = mean(outlier[divisional == "Divisional"]),
    nondiv_rate = mean(outlier[divisional == "Non-divisional"]),
    n_div       = sum(divisional == "Divisional"),
    p = prop.test(c(sum(outlier[divisional == "Divisional"]), sum(outlier[divisional == "Non-divisional"])),
                  c(sum(divisional == "Divisional"), sum(divisional == "Non-divisional")))$p.value,
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header("Divisional outlier rate test (2-sample proportion test)", Data_Label) %>%
  fmt_percent(c(div_rate, nondiv_rate), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_number(p, decimals = 3)
```

## Do divisional games score differently vs. the closing total?

```{r div-totals}
game_lvl <- sched %>%
  transmute(game_id, divisional = if_else(div_game == 1, "Divisional", "Non-divisional"),
            total_line, actual = home_score + away_score,
            vs_line = actual - total_line, over = actual > total_line)

game_lvl %>%
  group_by(divisional) %>%
  summarise(games = n(), avg_line = mean(total_line, na.rm = TRUE), avg_actual = mean(actual),
            avg_vs_line = mean(vs_line, na.rm = TRUE), over_rate = mean(over, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header("Divisional games vs. the closing total",
             sprintf("Welch t-test on (actual - line): p = %.3f",
                     t.test(vs_line ~ divisional, data = game_lvl)$p.value)) %>%
  fmt_number(c(avg_line, avg_actual, avg_vs_line), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_percent(over_rate, decimals = 1)
```

## Divisional correlation: stacks and bring-backs

```{r div-correlation}
# QB1 = highest-volume QB in the team-game; Pass-catcher 1 = WR/TE with highest prior opportunity share
qb1 <- df %>% filter(position == "QB") %>%
  group_by(game_id, team) %>% slice_max(vol, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(game_id, team, opponent, divisional, qb_fp = fp)

pc1 <- df %>% filter(position %in% c("WR", "TE"), !is.na(share_p4)) %>%
  group_by(game_id, team) %>% slice_max(share_p4, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(game_id, team, pc1_fp = fp)

team_fp <- ps_all %>% group_by(season, week, team) %>% summarise(team_fp = sum(fp), .groups = "drop") %>%
  inner_join(lines %>% select(game_id, season, week, team, opponent, divisional),
             by = c("season", "week", "team"))

pairs <- list(
  `QB + own pass-catcher (stack)` =
    qb1 %>% inner_join(pc1, by = c("game_id", "team")) %>% transmute(divisional, a = qb_fp, b = pc1_fp),
  `QB + opp pass-catcher (bring-back)` =
    qb1 %>% inner_join(pc1, by = c("game_id", "opponent" = "team")) %>% transmute(divisional, a = qb_fp, b = pc1_fp),
  `Team skill FP vs. opponent skill FP` =
    team_fp %>% inner_join(team_fp %>% select(game_id, team, opp_fp = team_fp),
                           by = c("game_id", "opponent" = "team")) %>%
      filter(team < opponent) %>% transmute(divisional, a = team_fp, b = opp_fp)
)

fisher_p <- function(r1, n1, r2, n2) 2 * pnorm(-abs((atanh(r1) - atanh(r2)) / sqrt(1/(n1 - 3) + 1/(n2 - 3))))

imap_dfr(pairs, function(d, nm) {
  s <- d %>% group_by(divisional) %>% summarise(r = cor(a, b, use = "complete.obs"), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  dv <- filter(s, divisional == "Divisional"); nd <- filter(s, divisional == "Non-divisional")
  tibble(pair = nm, r_div = dv$r, n_div = dv$n, r_nondiv = nd$r, n_nondiv = nd$n,
         diff = dv$r - nd$r, p = fisher_p(dv$r, dv$n, nd$r, nd$n))
}) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header("Fantasy-point correlation: divisional vs. non-divisional",
             "Fisher z-test for difference in correlations") %>%
  fmt_number(c(r_div, r_nondiv, diff), decimals = 3) %>%
  fmt_number(p, decimals = 3)
```

# Testing: which factors matter independently?

```{r model-setup}
num_vars <- c("total_line", "team_spread", "team_plays_p4", "opp_plays_allowed_p4", "team_proe_p4",
              "opp_fp_allowed_p4", "fp_p4", "share_p4", "wind_f", "temp_f", "rest")

dfm <- df %>%
  filter(venue != "Neutral") %>%
  mutate(home = as.numeric(venue == "Home"),
         div  = as.numeric(div_game == 1),
         indoor_n    = as.numeric(indoor),
         primetime_n = as.numeric(primetime)) %>%
  group_by(position) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(num_vars), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)), .names = "{.col}_z")) %>%   # per-SD effects
  ungroup()

model_terms <- function(pos) {
  v <- c(paste0(num_vars, "_z"), "home", "div", "indoor_n", "primetime_n")
  if (pos == "QB") v <- setdiff(v, "share_p4_z")
  v
}
model_data <- function(pos) {
  dfm %>% filter(position == pos) %>% drop_na(all_of(c("outlier", model_terms(pos))))
}

term_labels <- c(total_line_z = "Game total (+1 SD)", team_spread_z = "Spread, favored (+1 SD)",
                 team_plays_p4_z = "Team plays/g p4 (+1 SD)", opp_plays_allowed_p4_z = "Opp plays allowed/g p4 (+1 SD)",
                 team_proe_p4_z = "Team PROE p4 (+1 SD)", opp_fp_allowed_p4_z = "Opp FP allowed to pos p4 (+1 SD)",
                 fp_p4_z = "Player FP/g p4 (+1 SD)", share_p4_z = "Player opp. share p4 (+1 SD)",
                 wind_f_z = "Wind (+1 SD)", temp_f_z = "Temperature (+1 SD)", rest_z = "Rest days (+1 SD)",
                 home = "Home", div = "Divisional game", indoor_n = "Indoor", primetime_n = "Primetime / non-Sunday")

fits <- map(set_names(levels(df$position)), function(pos) {
  d <- model_data(pos)
  m <- glm(reformulate(model_terms(pos), "outlier"), data = d, family = binomial)
  co <- summary(m)$coefficients[-1, , drop = FALSE]
  lrt <- drop1(m, test = "LRT")
  list(
    n = nrow(d),
    coefs = tibble(term = rownames(co), est = co[, 1], se = co[, 2]) %>%
      mutate(odds_ratio = exp(est), lo = exp(est - 1.96 * se), hi = exp(est + 1.96 * se)),
    lrt = tibble(term = rownames(lrt), lrt_chisq = lrt$LRT, p = lrt[["Pr(>Chi)"]]) %>%
      filter(term != "<none>")
  )
})

coef_tbl <- imap_dfr(fits, ~ .x$coefs %>% left_join(.x$lrt, by = "term") %>% mutate(position = .y, n = .x$n)) %>%
  mutate(position = factor(position, levels = levels(df$position)),
         label = term_labels[term],
         sig = if_else(p < 0.05, "p < 0.05", "n.s."))
```

## Odds ratios (all factors in one model, per position)

```{r forest, fig.height=8}
ggplot(coef_tbl, aes(odds_ratio, fct_rev(factor(label, levels = term_labels)), colour = sig)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), size = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ position, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`p < 0.05` = "#d7301f", n.s. = "grey60")) +
  labs(x = "Odds ratio of an outlier week (log scale)", y = NULL, colour = "LRT",
       title = "Independent Effect of Each Factor",
       subtitle = paste0(Data_Label, "\nlogistic regression, all factors together; continuous = per 1 SD"),
       caption = paste("Data: nflreadr / nflfastR |", CREDIT)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "top")
```

## Factor significance ranking

```{r significance}
coef_tbl %>%
  select(position, label, odds_ratio, lrt_chisq, p) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = position, values_from = c(odds_ratio, lrt_chisq, p),
              names_glue = "{position}_{.value}") %>%
  mutate(avg_chisq = rowMeans(across(ends_with("_lrt_chisq")), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_chisq)) %>%
  select(label, starts_with("QB"), starts_with("RB"), starts_with("WR"), starts_with("TE")) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header("Likelihood-ratio test: drop each factor from the full model",
             "sorted by average LRT chi-square across positions") %>%
  fmt_number(ends_with("_odds_ratio"), decimals = 2) %>%
  fmt_number(ends_with("_lrt_chisq"), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_number(ends_with("_p"), decimals = 3) %>%
  data_color(columns = ends_with("_p"),
             fn = scales::col_numeric(c("#1b7837", "white"), domain = c(0, 0.2), na.color = "white"))

# Univariate check (binned factors, chi-square) for comparison
imap_dfr(screen_vars, ~ chi_p(filter(df, venue != "Neutral"), .x) %>% mutate(factor = .y)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = position, values_from = p) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header("Univariate chi-square p-values (binned factor vs. outlier)",
             "does NOT control for other factors") %>%
  fmt_number(-factor, decimals = 3)
```

## Out-of-sample test: do the extra factors add predictive value?

```{r oos}
auc <- function(y, p) {
  ok <- !is.na(y) & !is.na(p); y <- y[ok]; p <- p[ok]
  r <- rank(p); n1 <- sum(y); n0 <- sum(!y)
  (sum(r[y]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n0)
}

map_dfr(levels(df$position), function(pos) {
  d  <- model_data(pos)
  tr <- filter(d, season <  max(SEASONS))
  te <- filter(d, season == max(SEASONS))
  specs <- list(
    `Vegas only`          = c("total_line_z", "team_spread_z", "home"),
    `Vegas + player prior` = c("total_line_z", "team_spread_z", "home", "fp_p4_z",
                               if (pos != "QB") "share_p4_z"),
    `Full model`          = model_terms(pos)
  )
  imap_dfr(specs, function(v, nm) {
    m <- glm(reformulate(v, "outlier"), data = tr, family = binomial)
    tibble(position = pos, model = nm,
           auc = auc(te$outlier, predict(m, newdata = te, type = "response")),
           n_train = nrow(tr), n_test = nrow(te), test_outliers = sum(te$outlier))
  })
}) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(position, n_train, n_test, test_outliers), names_from = model, values_from = auc) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(sprintf("Out-of-sample AUC: train %d-%d, test %d (Wks 3-%d)",
                     min(SEASONS), max(SEASONS) - 1, max(SEASONS), THRU_WK),
             "0.5 = coin flip; gains of ~0.02+ are meaningful") %>%
  fmt_number(c(`Vegas only`, `Vegas + player prior`, `Full model`), decimals = 3)
```

# Context

## Did the game actually shoot out? (explains, does not predict)

```{r actual-vs-line}
df %>%
  mutate(total_miss = cut(game_total - total_line, c(-Inf, -10, -3, 3, 10, Inf),
                          labels = c("Under 10+", "Under 3-10", "Within 3", "Over 3-10", "Over 10+"))) %>%
  rate_by("total_miss") %>%
  plot_rate("Actual game total vs. closing line", "Outlier Rate by Game Script vs. Vegas")
```

## Biggest outliers in the current season

```{r current-outliers}
df %>%
  filter(season == max(SEASONS), outlier) %>%
  arrange(desc(z)) %>%
  transmute(Wk = week, Player = player, Pos = position, Team = team, Opp = opponent,
            Venue = venue, Div = if_else(div_game == 1, "Y", ""),
            Total = total_line, Spread = team_spread, ITT = round(implied_tt, 1),
            `Plays p4` = round(team_plays_p4, 1), `Opp allow p4` = round(opp_plays_allowed_p4, 1),
            `PROE p4` = round(team_proe_p4, 1), FP = round(fp, 1), z = round(z, 2)) %>%
  head(40) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(sprintf("%d in-week outliers (z >= %.1f)", max(SEASONS), Z_CUT))
```
